headline: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited to Acquire 64.26% Stake in Kronox Lab Sciences Limited
sum: Indo Borax & Chemicals has announced acquisition of 64.26% stake in Kronox Lab Sciences Limited, expanding the acquirer's portfolio in specialty chemicals and laboratory sciences.
implication: Majority stake acquisition (64.26%) establishes control under the Companies Act 2013 and triggers mandatory disclosures and potential delisting/fair value considerations if Kronox is public; substantive consolidation accounting implications for Indo Borax.
detail: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited, a listed industrial chemicals player, has announced via NSE press release dated 20 August 2026 its acquisition of a 64.26% stake in Kronox Lab Sciences Limited. The transaction represents a significant expansion into laboratory sciences and specialty chemical segments. Specific valuation, payment terms, regulatory approvals and closing conditions have not been disclosed in the available press announcement. The stake level triggers public disclosure obligations under SEBI Regulations and potentially triggers change-of-control provisions.
